# Stranger Mingle

> One of India's safest community platforms for making real, platonic friendships through organized weekend meetups, an exclusive members platform, and periodic online intercity events — across Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Delhi.

Stranger Mingle is built to solve a problem millions of Indians face: feeling lonely in a crowded city. Making friends after college shouldn't be this hard. We create safe, structured social spaces where strangers meet and genuine friendships begin — not online, but in real life.

Stranger Mingle is NOT a dating app, matrimonial service, or networking platform. It is exclusively focused on platonic friendships. All events are in-person (plus periodic online intercity meetups), held in public venues, facilitated by verified and trained hosts, and governed by a strict zero-harassment policy.

Founded by StrangerMingle, Pune, India.
